parsed.name: AreaDetector GatherN 数据汇聚插件
parsed.description: 这是一个用于面阵探测器数据采集链路的图像/数组汇聚插件组件，通常接在上游 areaDetector 插件之后，从源插件接收 NDArray 数据并进行成组汇集，供后续显示、处理或保存使用。它常见于同步辐射、显微成像和其他基于二维探测器的实验数据流程中。
parsed.description_en: This is an image/array gathering plugin component used in an area detector acquisition pipeline. It typically sits downstream of another areaDetector plugin, receives NDArray data from a source plugin, and groups or gathers the data for later display, processing, or file output. It is commonly used in synchrotron, microscopy, and other 2D detector-based experimental workflows.
